questions.needs_revision: Do the critique findings show at least one item whose status is wrong or unsupported, so the result must be revised before it is used?
questions.positive_despite_gate: Does any sample whose HGVS string was rejected by the nomenclature gate, or whose consent does not permit clinical return, receive report_ready or report_with_caveats?
questions.overreach_beyond_qc: Does the result claim any variant is pathogenic, or describe any report as signed or returned to a patient?
